Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of

As Director of Product Marketing for Tanium’s Autonomous MSP solution, you will own the positioning, messaging, launches, and partner-facing marketing for a growing part of Tanium’s business. jobs.title: Spacecraft Thermal Engineer (I/II)
jobs.description_text:
Join a team where your impact reaches beyond the stars! At Terran Orbital, you’re not just part of the system – you’re a vital force propelling our mission forward. As trailblazers in satellite manufacturing and aerospace innovation, we shatter boundaries daily to deliver groundbreaking solutions that power our nation’s defense and commercial missions. We are a unique, fast growing, and trusted team dedicated to swiftly and efficiently designing, building, launching, and operating state of the art satellites for advanced mission constellations. If you’re driven by purpose, inspired by challenges, and ready to leave your mark on the universe, you’ll find a home and endless opportunities for growth here. Together, let’s redefine what is possible in orbit and beyond!

Terran Orbital is seeking an experienced Spacecraft Thermal Engineer to join our growing team. Reporting to the Thermal Engineering Manager, the Spacecraft Thermal Engineer will be involved in all aspects of a spacecraft's development. They will support spacecraft thermal systems configuration from the concept level through design reviews, design verification, and operations. In addition to predictive and analytical work, the Sr. Engineers may serve in team leadership roles or as subject area experts.

We are open to a level I (Associate Engineer) or level II (Engineer) for this position.

jobs.title: Design Director, Men's Footwear
jobs.description_text:
Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike.

Tecovas is looking for a Senior Designer, Men's Footwear to create the next generation of iconic Western footwear. From concept to commercialization, you will lead the design of products that balance heritage craftsmanship with modern innovation, ensuring every style embodies the Tecovas brand. Reporting directly to the Head of Product, you will influence the future of the category through exceptional design, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of construction, materials, fit, and storytelling

This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the design and development of Tecovas Men's Footwear from concept through commercialization, ensuring every product reflects our commitment to craftsmanship, authenticity, and quality.
  • Drive seasonal design direction by identifying new opportunities across Western, work, and adjacent footwear categories while evolving our iconic franchises.
  • Lead all aspects of the design process, ensuring deliverables are met for seasonal milestone meetings, prototype reviews, line freeze, and production deadlines.

Reporting directly to the Design Director,  you will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn seasonal direction, market insights, and trend research into commercial product concepts that reflect the Tecovas brand.

This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

  • Support the design team in translating seasonal direction and trend research into fresh, globally relevant concepts.
  • Assist in developing upper designs, outsoles, trims, and embellishments that align with Tecovas’ aesthetic.

  • Participate in prototype reviews and help update tech packs based on feedback.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Menu & 3P
jobs.description_text:
Senior Product Manager, Menu & 3P Channel position. Sweetgreen is on a mission to build healthier communities by connecting people to real food. We passionately believe that real food should be convenient and accessible to everyone. Every day in each sweetgreen, our 5,000 team members make food from scratch, using fresh ingredients and produce delivered that morning. And in our local communities, we're committed to leaving people better than we found them. We're in the business of feeding people, and we're out to change what that means.

The Senior Product Manager, Menu & 3P Channel will own the product strategy and roadmap for sweetgreen's menu architecture, innovation, and third-party marketplace experience. You'll be responsible for how our menu is built, priced, and presented across every ordering surface, and for the health of our partnerships with delivery marketplaces like Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Grubhub. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, finance, and marketing—requiring someone who can translate commercial agreements and operational constraints into a menu and channel experience that's simple for guests and profitable for the business.
You will:
  • Own the end-to-end product strategy for menu architecture, including item structure, modifiers, pricing logic, and how new products (like Create Your Own and limited-time offers) are configured across app, web, kiosk, and third-party marketplaces

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Tubi's native app runtime for connected TVs on Cobalt, the lightweight, open-source browser engine behind YouTube on living room devices. This is a hybrid role which is two days in the SF office.

jobs.title: Construction Project Engineer
jobs.description_text:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

jobs.title: AI in Residence, Computational Protein Design
jobs.description_text:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

AI in Residence 

AI in Residence is a highly selective role at the intersection of frontier machine learning and drug discovery. Designed as an industry alternative to a traditional postdoctoral position, the program is for exceptional researchers and engineers who want to apply advanced AI to real biomedical problems end to end, from data to deployed systems. 

Residents join a small cohort working on high-impact AI efforts across Xaira. You'll collaborate closely with AI scientists, research engineers, and drug discovery teams to design, build, and ship machine learning capabilities that directly influence therapeutic programs. This is hands-on, system-level work with real scientific consequence.

jobs.title: Thermal Engineer II
jobs.description_text:
The Thermal Engineer for Voyager Lunar Systems is responsible for supporting the design, build, test, and operation of thermal control system components for spacecraft, including lunar landers and surface power systems.

The position reports to the Propulsion and Thermal Systems Manager within the Engineering Department in Pittsburgh, PA. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, integration, testing, and operation of thermal control systems for spacecraft, lunar landers, lunar surface power, lunar rovers, and other space systems
  • Support the thermal team by creating conceptual and detailed designs of spacecraft thermal system components and spacecraft hardware
  • Build and run component and spacecraft thermal models to guide design and operational decisions
  • Provide support in creating specifications for vendor supplied components, and support the thermal team in validating component performance
  • Provide support during spacecraft assembly in the cleanroom
  • Provide thermal team support for in-house TVAC (thermal vacuum chamber) testing of components, and support external thermal testing as required
  • Train in mission operations procedures and provide real time mission operations support

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or similar Engineering with 2 years of experience in thermal technologies, OR a Mast
